title: 1667 Shamakhi earthquake
summary: The English Wikipedia article "1667 Shamakhi earthquake", at revision 1366163498, opens: "The 1667 Shamakhi earthquake occurred on 25 November 1667 with an epicenter close to the city of Shamakhi, Azerbaijan. It had an estimated surface-wave magnitude of 6.9 and a maximum felt intensity of X (Extreme) on the Mercalli intensity scale. An estimated 80,000 people died." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4551686, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1667 seismic event centered near present-day Shamakhi, Azerbaijan". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
